value.rationale: The discrepancy changes the admissible policy set and the optimization geometry rather than only notation. The stated triangle excludes valid allocations, including the paper's own reported Wuhan split, and the boundary line search imposes an artificial tradeoff between two within-stratum decisions. Restoring the square both reconciles the case study with the model and gives an exact decoupled instantaneous minimax value, which is directly useful for reproducing or extending the allocation method.
